_comment: Human-curated causal layer. Every edge needs rationale+source. Metric numbers are NOT stored here (parsed from files by build.py); ACCEPTED_BECAUSE edges cite the metric id that build.py creates. JSON format = YAML-compatible subset, stdlib-only parsing.

hypotheses.label: Blind uncentered invariance (L_inv all tokens) improves OOD transfer
Asymmetric inv (inv_head MLP, BYOL-style) fixes rank collapse AND OOD
Per-probe L2 waveform-invariant tokenizer (dropping spectral mag) fixes OOD
Unsupervised calibration readout (P1u_s2 + Otsu) is the deployable default on Hall
Nonlinear probe (MLP) on calibrated features unlocks transfer
Selective inv on sound-metal tokens only (oracle mask Stage 0) preserves class signal
Energy-adaptive tokenizer front-end improves Chirp/TMR OOD (trades off Rivet_v2/Sizing contrast)
Continuous 2D coordinate pos_mlp (Option A) + non-enclosing contiguous wedge masking + scan-centered L_inv fixes FM7/FM8/FM11

failures.label: Blind-inv washout: aligning defect-coupled tokens across conditions destroys class signal (over-invariance)
Train-scan telemetry optimism: pre-fix telemetry measured TRAIN scans, not the 4 canonical val files
Probe sign/direction rotates per condition: supervised directions that work on Hall fail on TMR
P2 is a polarity mirror (1-P0 on hard files), not a learned TMR defect direction
Mahalanobis readout is ~0.667 across same-tokenizer dual_domain runs (021809/135025/exp51/exp54), but rises to 0.695 on exp53
L_inv amplitude-shrinkage hijack: direct uncentered inv with offset_weight>0 collapses rank (10->1.2D)

Train-inference spatial token & pos_embed mismatch: ContextEncoder trained only on 16 outer probes (9..24) while pos_embed[0:9] received zero grad in Encoder (trained only in Predictor), yet extract_features feeds all 25 probes to ContextEncoder

LayerNorm DC-bias needle bypass of L_inv: when offset_weight=0 (021809, exp52, exp53), context_encoder.norm.bias[32:] inflates 34-37x (9.51-13.27, DC/AC=198-248) so raw cos=0.990-0.996 while scan-centered cos is only 0.105-0.127

Small-group sound-metal noise amplification: scan_id=pair_idx (112 pairs -> 2.28 samples/group in batch 256) with pool_var_weight=0.5 + offset_weight=0.005 forces patch-mean variance on sound noise, driving pred_loss 1.07->1.74 before L_inv starts at ep 15

Pretraining val leakage & metric blindness: PairedPECTDataset loads all 16 Base Domain scans (12 train + 4 val = 112 pairs); per-scan Mahalanobis val_auc is blind to cross-condition rotation; global batch R_eff (38.9D) hides within-scan z_s rank (1.49-1.68D)

Per-probe (dim=-1) temporal normalization erases within-patch spatial amplitude contrast ||x_center||/||x_ring||, degrading Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) and Sizing R2 (+0.238->-0.101) in exp53 and collapsing sizing (-5.07) in exp52

Rank-deficient full-ZCA eigenvector rotation & carrier shortcut: within-scan R_eff(z_s)=1.49-1.98D causes 64x64 ZCA whitening (P1u_s2) to rotate noise axes on TMR (0.554->0.428 P1); predictor reading H_ctx_c leaks condition info

invariants.label: Hardware offsets via unsupervised spatial self-calibration; no cross-sensor penalties (GEMINI.md s4)
Pure SSL: no waveform/sensor metadata injection (GEMINI.md s3)
Check-before-proposing: consult registry/graph before new directions (GEMINI.md s2)
Causal chain required: Code/Math -> Optimization -> Latent geometry -> Downstream (GEMINI.md s5)
Zero metric recycling: claims about a checkpoint need that checkpoint's own measurements (GEMINI.md s5)

readouts.label: P0 LR on raw scattering (legacy baseline)
P1u_s2 LR: unsupervised bg stats + shrinkage s2 (deploy default on Hall; degrades TMR via FM12)
Otsu threshold replacing fixed 0.5 for IoU
P3 supervised (best on exp51 only, not transferable)
Official MLP probe on raw features (sanity anchor)
Mahalanobis distance readout (0.6948 Test AUC on exp53, 0.6792 on TMR, 0.7817 on Chirp)

exp49_inv_xcov_20261014_021809.verdict: Best ckpt is ep 93/100 (after 63 ep of full L_inv=0.5, NOT pre-inv). Avoided rank collapse via FM8: offset_weight=0 allowed LN_bias[32:]=13.265 (DC/AC=198.1) so raw cos=0.9899 while scan-centered cos=0.1047. Test LP 0.5543 (P0), P1u_s2 0.5563, Maha 0.6679.

exp49_inv_xcov_20261014_135025.verdict: Diverged inv run (best ep 33, pred_loss=1.143, test LP 0.5536, Maha 0.6738). Evidence for FM6.

exp49_inv_xcov_20261014_161630.verdict: Added offset_weight=0.005 + pool_var_weight=0.5 with cov=0.05: blocked FM8 DC needle, causing direct L_inv to collapse global R_eff to 1.21D at ep 32 (FM6).

exp51_asyminv_20261015_013636.verdict: Best ep 94/100. Confounded by FM9 (pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005 drove pred_loss 1.07->1.72 by ep 15 before L_inv). Test LP 0.4729; fixing FM7 inference path (16-ctx+Pred0) jumps Corrosion z1 TMR AUC 0.2925->0.5809.

exp52_waveforminv_tokenizer_20261015_130.verdict: Best ep 19/34. Per-probe L2 norm + dropping spectral mag (FM11) collapsed sizing R2 (-5.07 test, -11.56 val) and OOD LP (0.4747), while LN_bias[32:]=3.414 bypassed L_inv (FM8).

exp53_energyadaptive_tokenizer_20261015_.verdict: Best ep 90/100. Clean 1-var ablation vs 021809 (both have offset_weight=0, pool_var_weight=0; LN_bias[32:]=9.505 via FM8). Best Test LP 0.5630, MLPraw 0.5732, Maha 0.6948. Boosts Only-Chirp (0.562->0.640) and Only-TMR (0.529->0.555, Maha 0.592->0.679), but per-probe dim=-1 norm (FM11) regresses Only-Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) and Val Sizing R2 (+0.238->-0.101). Fixing FM7 inference jumps Corrosion z1 TMR AUC 0.5168->0.6306.

exp54_selective_oracle_20261015_223926.verdict: Best ep 74/89. Confounded by FM9: pred_loss rose 1.068->1.733 in ep 1..15 while L_inv=0 due to pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005. Against matched baseline exp51, H6 mask IMPROVED Test LP (0.4729->0.4929), Val AP (0.0543->0.1641, 3x), Only-Chirp (0.433->0.485), Only-TMR (0.420->0.448), and achieved highest Test auc_oracle (0.7929).

exp55_energyadaptive_clean_20261016_1415.verdict: DEAD, do not relaunch: premise false (exp53 vs 021809 was already clean 1-var) + live FM9 (pred 1.09->1.45 ep1-11 pre-inv, rank 13.8D->3.5D, R_eff floor FAIL, no best ever saved). Process ended ep16.

edges.rationale: 63 epochs of full L_inv=0.5 (best ep 93), but L_inv was bypassed by LN_bias[32:]=13.265 needle (FM8), leaving scan-centered cosine at 0.1047.
100ep asymmetric inv with offset_weight=0.005 + pool_var=0.5: rank held at 7.8D (1.98D within-scan) yet OOD LP dropped to 0.4729.
inv_head MLP BYOL-style; rank fix yes, OOD fix no (also licenses cross-condition rotation in encoder).
waveform_invariant tokenizer arm, best ep 19/34.
Oracle GT sound-mask inv on top of exp51 config (confounded by FM9 pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005).
Clean single-variable ablation of 021809 with energy_adaptive tokenizer (both have offset_weight=0, pool_var_weight=0).
Blind uncentered L_inv either gets bypassed by LN_bias needle when offset_weight=0 (FM8) or collapses/rotates features when offset_weight>0 (FM1/FM6).
edges.source: checkpoint weight & forward pass forensics on 9 Corrosion z1 scans

edges.rationale: In 021809 and exp53, LN_bias[32:] grew to 13.265 and 9.505 (DC/AC=198-246), making raw cos=0.990-0.996 while scan-centered cos=0.105-0.127.
Per-probe L2 normalization + deleting spectral mag destroys spatial scattering contrast and collapses sizing R2 to -5.07 (test) / -11.56 (val).
MLPp1u_s2 0.544 < LR-P1u_s2 0.556 on 021809; TMR weak for LR and MLP alike: wrong direction, not missing capacity.
Partial: asym-inv holds global rank 7.8D with zero guard trips (fixes collapse), but permits encoder rotation across conditions.
P1u_s2 reproduces supervised P1_s2 without GT on Hall (021809: 0.556/0.055), though full 64x64 ZCA degrades TMR via FM12.

Clean single-variable gain over 021809: test LP 0.5630 > 0.5543, Test Maha 0.6948 > 0.6679, Only-Chirp LP 0.562->0.640, Only-TMR LP 0.529->0.555 (Maha 0.592->0.679), with tradeoff on Only-Rivet_v2 (0.592->0.486) due to FM11.

Confounded in exp54 by FM9 (pool_var=0.5 + offset=0.005 caused pred_loss 1.068->1.733 in ep 1..15 while L_inv=0). Beat matched exp51 across all metrics (LP +0.020, Val AP 3x, auc_oracle 0.7929); requires clean retest without FM9.
Best single supervised probe on exp53 (MLPraw 0.5732 > LR-P1u_s2 0.5669 same ckpt) but cannot rescue rotated directions on its own.
corr(P0,P2)=-0.77 exp51 / -0.38 021809: P2 inverts P0, accidentally right on TMR (0.58) where P0 is already wrong (0.38).
Across all 12 evaluated runs, Test Maha scales from 0.5226 (no_vicreg) -> 0.6216 (exp48) -> 0.6679 (021809) -> 0.6948 (exp53), outperforming supervised LP by +0.1318 AUC on exp53.
Same as H5: nonlinear probe cannot rescue wrong per-condition direction.
L_inv over all 16 context tokens incl. defect-coupled pixels.
Direct encoder pull shrinks defect norm when DC offset is blocked and cov weight is low (exp49_161630, exp55).
Fixed 0..8 target mask + torch.no_grad() on TargetEncoder starves pos_embed[0:9] of Encoder gradients; extract_features feeds all 25 tokens to ContextEncoder.
Uncentered cosine L_inv allows context_encoder.norm.bias[32:] to grow to 9.5-13.3 when offset_weight=0.
scan_id=pair_idx has only 2.28 patches/batch (98.8% sound metal); pool_var_weight=0.5 forces patch-mean variance on uncorrelated sound noise.
PairedPECTDataset loads all 16 Base Domain scans (12 train + 4 val) when file_paths is omitted in train.py:217; per-scan Mahalanobis val_auc is rotation-invariant.
Per-probe temporal std normalization (dim=-1) equalizes all 25 probes in a patch to unit variance, weakening spatial amplitude ratio ||x_center||/||x_ring||.
Full 64x64 SVD whitening on within-scan rank 1.49-1.98D amplifies 62 noise eigenvectors and rotates coordinates on TMR.
Old telemetry monitored 2 TRAIN scans; fixed to 4 canonical val scans with GT.
Asymmetric route: encoder never directly pulled; rank collapse cured (not OOD).
Stage-0 hypothesis: align sound tokens only; improved exp54 over matched exp51 (+0.020 Test LP, 3x Val AP).
Option A continuous 2D coordinate MLP pos_mlp(dr, dc) + decoupled predictor target_pos_proj.
16 non-enclosing contiguous wedge masks ensure all 25 probes (incl. center 0 at 8/16 context, 8/16 target) are trained in ContextEncoder without context/target interleaving.

Batch-mean centering (dim 0,1) cancels the scan-independent LayerNorm bias inside cosine without needing offset/pool weights. Per-scan-conditioned offsets (FM3) survive; per-scan EMA version still open.
Zeros out H_ctx_c before predictor so predictor cannot use carrier c_A as a cross-condition shortcut.
Default readout on Hall: +50% AP, +0.01 AUC, 100% unsupervised calibration.
Replaces fixed 0.5 threshold for IoU eval.
Blind cross-condition penalty corrupts the pretraining manifold instead of unsupervised self-calibration.

Stage-0 oracle sound mask over 16 context probes (inv_oracle_mask)
Discrete pos_embed[1,25,D] with fixed 0..8 target / 9..24 context mask
Option A continuous 2D coordinate MLP pos_mlp(dr,dc) + decoupled predictor target_pos_proj (continuous_pos_embed)
Predictor restricted to scattering subspace H_ctx_s only (predictor_scattering_only)
Pooled variance hinge (pool_var_weight=0.5) on 2.28-sample pair_idx groups + offset_weight=0.005
Legacy telemetry on TRAIN scans / unsplit PairedPECTDataset
